panels.title: Diagnostic lability

series.name: Diagnostic lability
series.color: black notched boxes (ZODIAC's box filled blue-grey #345B7D), dotted dark-red whiskers and caps

notes: Notched box plot: value = median (thick black line), err_lo / err_hi = whisker cap positions; quartiles and notch ends: ZODIAC: Q1 0.0024, Q3 0.0070, notch 0.0019-0.0054; GPT-4o: Q1 0.0552, Q3 0.1353, notch 0.0589-0.1218; Gemini-Pro: Q1 0.0053, Q3 0.1035, notch 0.0116-0.0887; Llama-3.1-405B: Q1 0.0035, Q3 0.1631, notch 0.0460-0.1642; Mixtral-8x22B: Q1 0.1102, Q3 0.1581, notch 0.1078-0.1454; BioGPT-Large: Q1 0.0701, Q3 0.1811, notch 0.0834-0.1705; Meditron-70B: Q1 0.0254, Q3 0.0738, notch 0.0375-0.0755; Med42-70B: Q1 0.0175, Q3 0.0405, notch 0.0247-0.0427

Outliers (grey diamonds; drawn with transparency, so the PDF rasterises them: read from a 20x render, +/-0.002): ZODIAC about 0.020; Mixtral-8x22B about 0.009 and 0.000; BioGPT-Large about 0.355 and 0.359 (two overlapping markers each for Mixtral and BioGPT)

Read from the PDF path objects (pypdfium2): y calibrated on the three tick marks 0.0 / 0.2 / 0.4 at page y 647.65 / 676.525 / 705.40 pt (144.4 pt per unit, residual of the middle tick 0.000); coordinates are printed to 0.01 pt = 0.00007 units. The bottom spine sits at -0.018, the top frame line at 0.4.

Tick labels are printed on two lines broken at a hyphen ('Gemini' / '-Pro', 'Llama-3.1' / '-405B', 'Mixtral' / '-8x22B', 'BioGPT' / '-Large', 'Meditron' / '-70B', 'Med42' / '-70B'); they are joined without a space. No y-axis label is printed; the quantity (variance of pairwise cosine similarities over 10 runs, per the text) is named by the sub-caption '(a) Diagnostic lability'.
For Llama-3.1-405B and Mixtral-8x22B the notch extends past a quartile (notch end 0.1642 > Q3 0.1631; notch end 0.1078 < Q1 0.1102), as matplotlib draws notches wider than the box.

panels.title: Signle-agent v.s. multi-agent
notes: 'Signle-agent' is spelled that way in the legend and in the sub-caption '(b) Signle-agent v.s. multi-agent'.

Read from the PDF path objects (pypdfium2): value = top edge of each bar rectangle; y calibrated on the three tick marks 1 / 3 / 5 at page y 644.87 / 675.095 / 705.32 pt (15.11 pt per unit, residual of the middle tick 0.0003). All 16 bar tops land within 0.001 of a multiple of 0.01. The y axis starts at 1 (bars are drawn from 0 and clipped by the frame); bars at 5.0 (FFB) touch the top frame line.
The legend box covers the lower part of the CNS, FFH and FFB bars (that region is rasterised in the PDF); the bar tops are above it and unaffected.

Cross-check: the 'Multi-agent (this work)' bars equal the ZODIAC row of the paper's results table (p. 8): ACC 4.4, CPL 4.5, ORG 4.7, CPH 4.9, SCI 4.4, CNS 4.5, FFH 4.8, FFB 5.0. No y-axis label is printed (1-5 rating scale).

uncertain: Panel a is kind 'box' (value = median, err_lo/err_hi = whiskers, quartiles and outliers in the notes, as the labelling rules prescribe); the scorer compares the medians only, normalised by the y range 0.418.

The bundle crop (images/picture_006.png) does not show panel a exactly as the PDF does: three small regions that the PDF stores as rasterised patches (around the ZODIAC box, the Mixtral-8x22B low outliers and the BioGPT-Large outliers) are drawn upside-down in the crop. For ZODIAC the crop therefore shows, besides the real box at about 0.005, a spurious thick black bar at about 0.04 with an inverted diamond under it; for Mixtral-8x22B the outlier markers are mirrored about the 0.0 line region and a black fragment sits below the axis. The truth follows the PDF (ZODIAC median 0.0036; vector paths and a pdfium render agree). A reader that takes the black bar for the ZODIAC box is off by 0.09 of the axis range. The crop also draws the dotted whiskers as solid lines. Panel b is not affected in its data marks.
Panel a outlier values are approximate (rasterised semi-transparent markers) and are in the notes only.

All axis text in this figure is drawn as glyph outlines (not in the PDF text layer); labels were read from an 8x render. Only the sub-captions '(a) Diagnostic lability' and '(b) Signle-agent v.s. multi-agent' are real text.
Neither panel prints a y-axis name; panel a's single series is named after its sub-caption.
bbox_px splits the crop at x = 280 px (between panel a's right end, 277 px, and panel b's y tick labels); both boxes include tick labels and the sub-caption line.
